nativeEvidence.help: REROLL kills the current character and returns to character creation; SET KEEP controls whether the replacement receives retained experience.

runtime.characterReplacement: RuntimeCharacterService.RerollCharacter builds a fresh level-1 character and RuntimeCharacterRepository.ReplaceCharacter atomically replaces the account slot.
retainedState: experience only, when SET KEEP and global KEEPEXP permit it
runtime.sessionHandoff: ServerNetworkHost reroll flow swaps the live session to the replacement character after commit.
